item.title: Headline Above the Coach

turns.text: Make a 4:5 social image of a smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio. Put “Start where you are” at the top, not over her face. Keep it upbeat, no other text.

item.tests: Checks that the finished composition reserves top space for the headline and keeps the face unobscured.

answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Start where you are” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Headline placement: At the top of the image, above the coach's face, without overlapping it.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: 4:5 portrait social image; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Person and setting: An invented smiling female fitness coach in a bright studio; no reference photo.

must_haves: The headline reads exactly “Start where you are” and sits in the top portion of the image.
No headline letters overlap the coach's face; her full face remains visible.
A smiling female fitness coach is clearly depicted in a bright studio.
The headline is readable, fully inside the canvas, and accompanied by no other text.

style.prompt: Create an upbeat polished social media fitness image, square composition. A smiling adult female fitness coach wearing tasteful athletic clothing in a bright, airy fitness studio with abundant natural light. Friendly, encouraging expression, professional photographic look, fresh cheerful colors. At the top, clearly legible headline with exactly these words: "Start where you are". Place the headline above her head with ample separation, never over her face. No other text, logos, labels, watermarks or lettering anywhere. IMPORTANT CROP-SAFE COMPOSITION: keep the complete headline and the coach inside the central 80 percent of the image width, with generous empty side margins, so the square can be cropped centrally to 4:5 without losing the headline or subject. Keep comfortable top margin above headline.
